title: Led a proof of concept to run ultrasound tests on virtual machines
summary: I led a phase 1 proof of concept in which Software Excellence and the Ultrasound team moved a simulator test suite from physical hardware to virtual machines.
what_would_have_happened: Tests would stay tied to scarce physical machines, with little room for automation or parallel runs.
the_call: Prove virtualization with a narrow first phase before asking the business for more.
what_i_did: Coordinated the people who produced the OS image, the virtual machine setup and the test run, then shared the result with Ultrasound R&D and credited everyone involved.
what_changed: Both sanity suites passed on a virtual machine in about 3 minutes; an engineering leader called the work the 'art of possibility'.

quotes.text: Many thanks to each of the teammates who helped think through the 'art of possibility'.
